newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle at $107/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle at $107/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was very active, with all buying concerns participating through the entire day, USDA said.
Seller interest also excellent. Live sales fully $1.00 per cwt higher; dressed sales $1.00-$2.00 higher.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs - few 65.00- 66.00; dressed basis 106.00-107.00, few early to 105.00. ( weighted average 106.28 ).

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - few 65.00- 66.00; dressed basis 106.00-107.00. ( weighted average 106.25 ). Confirmed - 35,000 Last Week - 18,600 Last Year - 25,800 For week - 41,200 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 87,800 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 46,800
